name: getlib-mcp
description: GetLib MCP - powerful modular self-hostable library docs MCP server and dashboard (Context7 alternative)

scripts.build:mcp: bun build src/server/mcp/stdio-entry.ts --outfile dist/mcp.js --target node --format esm --minify --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/mcp.js
scripts.check:no-em-dash: rg -lP "\x{2014}" --glob '!node_modules/**' --glob '!.next/**' --glob '!.git/**' --glob '!bun.lock' --glob '!AGENTS.md' . && echo 'EM DASH FOUND' && exit 1 || (rg -lP '\\u2014|—|—' src/app src/web --glob '*.tsx' --glob '*.css' && echo 'EM DASH CIRCUMVENTION FOUND' && exit 1 || echo 'no-em-dash: clean')
scripts.validate: bun run typecheck && bun run check:no-em-dash && bun test && bun run build
